title: AI-focused hedge fund sells all of its stocks
excerpt: Situational Awareness, an AI -focused hedge fund founded by a former OpenAI researcher, has sold all of its public equities portfolio to Ken Griffin's Citade...
content_html:
Dan Primack

Thu, July 30, 2026 at 9:18 AM MST 1 min read

Situational Awareness, an AI-focused hedge fund founded by a former OpenAI researcher, has sold all of its public equities portfolio to Ken Griffin's Citadel, a source tells Axios.

Why it matters: This comes amidst a recent sell-off in AI stocks, particularly chipmakers.

  • News of a sale was first reported by the WSJ.

Catch up quick: Former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner founded Situational Awareness after being fired from OpenAI in 2024, over an alleged information leak that he disputes. It recently reported around $20 billion in assets under management.

  • Early investors included Stripe cofounders Patrick and John Collison, plus former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman, and ex-Apple employee Daniel Gross.

Zoom in: Just yesterday, the FT reported that Situational Awareness "has sought to raise fresh capital from investors after suffering heavy losses during the recent rout in AI stocks."

  • That seems to have escalated quickly.

content_html_zh:
丹·普里马克

2026 年 7 月 30 日星期四上午 9:18（MST） 阅读 1 分钟

消息人士告诉 Axios，由前 OpenAI 研究员创立的专注于人工智能的对冲基金 Situational Awareness 已将其所有公开股票投资组合出售给 Ken Griffin 的 Citadel。

为什么重要：这是在最近人工智能股票（尤其是芯片制造商）遭遇抛售的背景下发生的。

  • 《华尔街日报》首先报道了出售的消息。

快点追上：前 OpenAI 研究员 Leopold Aschenbrenner 于 2024 年因涉嫌信息泄露而被 OpenAI 解雇，随后创立了 Situational Awareness，他对此提出异议。 该公司最近报告称其管理的资产约为 200 亿美元。

  • 早期投资者包括 Stripe 联合创始人 Patrick 和 John Collison，以及 GitHub 前首席执行官 Nat Friedman 和前苹果员工 Daniel Gross。

放大：就在昨天，英国《金融时报》报道称，态势感知“在最近人工智能股票暴跌期间遭受重创后，已寻求从投资者那里筹集新资金”。

  • 这似乎升级得很快。
